svg.title: Anubis spawns
svg.desc: All Anubis spawns. Gold: T. Blue: CT. Filled circles: competitive, numbered as on setpos.gg. Muted boxes E1, E2: extra 1, extra 2 within each side; dashed boxes are disabled 2v2 entities. Short ticks show spawn facing from demo checks or map entities. Linked numbers open available spawn pages.
